post.summary: Creates a Customer account and signs it in.
Returns a JWT for valid credentials.

get.summary: All catalogue categories, sorted by name.

post.summary: Adds a category (Admin). The slug is made from the name when left empty.

put.summary: Replaces a category's name, slug and description (Admin).

delete.summary: Deletes an empty category (Admin). Returns 409 while it still has items.

get.summary: One page of the rentable item catalogue.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive text matched against name, brand and description.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description:
First rental day (inclusive). With DateOnly? ItemListQuery.To, each item says whether it is free on those days;
items that are taken are still listed.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Last rental day (inclusive). Give both dates or neither.

post.summary: Adds an item to the catalogue (Admin).

put.summary: Replaces an item's details (Admin). Existing rentals keep the prices they were booked with.

delete.summary: Retires an item (Admin): it leaves the catalogue but stays in the rental history.

get.summary: Booked days of an item between two dates, and whether the whole range is free.
get.description: Only Booked, Issued and Overdue rentals take days. An item that is out past its end date stays taken until today.

get.summary: All rentals for the staff desk, newest start date first (Staff, Admin).
get.description:
Filter by status with `?status=Issued&status=Overdue`, and by the days a rental covers with
`from` and `to`: a rental is listed when any of its days falls in that range.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: Only rentals in one of these statuses. Repeat the parameter for several; leave it out for all.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Only rentals that end on or after this day.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Only rentals that start on or before this day.

post.summary: Books an item for the signed-in customer (Customer).
post.description:
The price, discount and deposit are calculated on the server, as in `GET /api/rentals/quote`.
Returns 409 when a Booked, Issued or Overdue rental already takes any of the days.
An item that is out past its end date stays taken until today.

get.summary: Rentals that should have been returned: Issued or Overdue, past their end date (Service, Staff, Admin).
get.description:
Oldest end date first. Issued rentals in the list are not marked yet; call `mark-late` for each one.
Overdue rentals stay in the list until they are returned, so calling `mark-late` again charges the new late days.

post.summary: Marks a rental past its end date as Overdue and brings its late fee up to date (Service, Staff, Admin).
post.description:
The late fee is one charge of the rental's `lateFeePerDay` (copied from the item, seeded as 150 % of the
daily price) for each day from the day after the end date up to today. Each day is charged once, so calling
this again recalculates the fee up to today instead of adding duplicates; it is safe to retry.
Issued → Overdue is saved in the status history. Returns 409 when the rental is not Issued or Overdue,
or its end date has not passed yet.

patch.summary: Changes a rental's status (Customer, Staff, Admin).
patch.description:
Allowed changes: Booked → Issued (staff, from the start date to the end date), Booked → Cancelled
(the customer who booked it, or staff), Issued → Returned and Overdue → Returned (staff).
Returning an item after its end date charges each late day at the rental's late fee, up to the day of return.
Any other change is a 409; a change allowed only for staff is a 403 for customers.
Every change is saved in the status history with the time and the user.

get.summary: The signed-in customer's rentals, newest first.
Price of renting an item for a date range, before booking.
get.description:
The discount comes from the longest discount tier the rental length reaches.
The deposit is refundable and is not included in `totalPrice`. The quote does not check availability.

BookedRangeDto.description: Days on which an item is already taken.

itemCount.description: Items of the category in the catalogue now; retired items are not counted.

slug.description: URL name such as `gaming-consoles`. Made from the name when left empty.

oneOf.description: New status: `Issued` or `Returned` (staff), or `Cancelled` (customer or staff).

note.description: Optional note saved in the status history, e.g. the condition of a returned item.

CreateRentalRequest.description: Body of `POST /api/rentals`: the item and the days to book, e.g. `{ "itemId": 1, "from": "2026-12-01", "to": "2026-12-07" }`.

isAvailable.description: True when no booked range overlaps From–To.

bookedRanges.description: Taken ranges that overlap the requested range, earliest first.

ItemSpecificationDto.description:
One line of an item's specifications: a camelCase `Key` the client translates
(`cpu`, `ram`, `sensor`, …) and the `Value` shown as written.

isAvailable.description:
Whether the item is free on every day of the `from`–`to` range of the request;
null when the request has no dates.

ItemSummaryDto.description: One item in the catalogue list.

lateFeePerDay.description: Fee for each day the item is returned late, copied from the item when booking.

lateFeeTotal.description: Sum of the late fees charged so far: LateDays × LateFeePerDay.

subtotal.description: Daily price × days, before the discount.

discountPercent.description: Percent of the best discount tier the rental length reaches, or 0.

discountAmount.description: Subtotal × discount percent, rounded to cents.

deposit.description: Refundable deposit taken at pickup; not part of TotalPrice.

RentalQuoteDto.description: Price of renting one item from From to To (both inclusive).

lateFeePerDay.description: Fee for each day the item is returned late, copied from the item when booking.

lateFeeTotal.description: Sum of the late fees charged so far: LateDays × LateFeePerDay.

StaffRentalDto.description: A rental as staff see it: the customer's rental plus who booked it and when it was issued and returned.

Bearer.description: Paste the accessToken returned by POST /api/auth/login.
